decisive_items: homogeneously low in signal on T2-weighted images
thin rim of enhancement with no internal enhancement
response.rationale: Meningioma classically shows extra-axial location, T2 hypointensity, and peripheral enhancement without internal enhancement; nerve sheath tumors (schwannoma, neurofibroma) typically show T2 hyperintensity and more avid enhancement.

rejected.why: Schwannoma usually T2 hyperintense with heterogeneous enhancement, not homogeneously low T2 or thin rim only.
Neurofibroma typically T2 hyperintense and enhances more uniformly; lacks the described rim pattern.
